how_it_works_page.title: How It Works
how_it_works_page.subtitle: Discover how Roadtripeado turns trip planning into effortless adventures with curated digital maps.
how_it_works_page.step1_desc: Explore our growing catalog of hand-crafted city maps. From the romantic streets of Paris to the hidden alleys of Oaxaca, discover curated places, local food scenes, and top destinations tailored to your vibe.
how_it_works_page.step1_f1: Filter by travel style, interests, or cuisine
how_it_works_page.step1_f2: Preview top-rated spots and reviews in each city
how_it_works_page.step1_f3: Real-time updates curated by verified locals
how_it_works_page.step2_desc: Unlock detailed secret locations, full addresses, high-res photos, and exclusive member discounts with a single one-time purchase. No subscriptions or recurring fees.
how_it_works_page.step2_f1: Lifetime access across all your desktop & mobile devices
how_it_works_page.step2_f2: Special discount perks for partner cafes, tours, and restaurants
how_it_works_page.step2_f3: Instant Google Maps navigation sync with 1-click directions
how_it_works_page.step3_title: Explore the City Like an Insider
how_it_works_page.step3_desc: Open your interactive web map and navigate effortlessly. Filter by category, access insider advice, and claim unique local offers as you explore.
how_it_works_page.step3_f1: Direct GPS routing and accurate opening hours
how_it_works_page.step3_f2: Audio guides, photos, and historical background
how_it_works_page.why_subtitle: Everything you need for an unforgettable journey without the tourist traps.
how_it_works_page.why_1_desc: No generic automated algorithms. Every single spot is hand-picked and verified by locals who know the city best.
how_it_works_page.why_2_desc: Pay once and keep the map forever. Enjoy free future spot updates without monthly renewal surprises.
how_it_works_page.why_3_desc: Save money with exclusive perks and member deals at partner bakeries, restaurants, and hidden cocktail bars.
how_it_works_page.why_4_desc: One-click directions directly integrated with Google Maps for smooth on-the-go exploration.
how_it_works_page.faq_subtitle: Got questions about how Roadtripeado works? We have answers.
how_it_works_page.faq_q1: How do I access my maps after purchasing?
how_it_works_page.faq_a1: Immediately after checkout, your purchased map appears in your profile under 'Purchased Maps'. You can open and explore it anytime on desktop, tablet, or phone.
how_it_works_page.faq_q2: Do I need to download an app?
how_it_works_page.faq_a2: No app download is required! Roadtripeado runs smoothly in any modern web browser on your phone, tablet, or computer.
how_it_works_page.faq_q3: Can I get directions to each spot?
how_it_works_page.faq_a3: Yes! Every location card includes a 'Get Directions' button that opens directly in Google Maps for turn-by-turn routing.
how_it_works_page.faq_q4: How do I redeem local discounts?
how_it_works_page.faq_a4: Simply click on any spot with an offer badge and hit 'Redeem Offer' to present the digital voucher or promo code directly to the merchant.
how_it_works_page.cta_title: Ready to Experience Cities Like a Local?
how_it_works_page.cta_desc: Browse our curated map collection today and start planning the road trip of your dreams.
